title: demo.aadhaar_okyc@v1 verify_otp response (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: The OTP is correct and the Aadhaar exists: the minimal e-KYC data a verification needs. Not returned on purpose: the photo, the full address, care-of, e-mail, mobile hash, the offline XML and its share code. A wrong or expired OTP is a 422 UPSTREAM_REJECTED error, not a response. Callers must ignore unknown fields.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) when UIDAI holds the full date, else null.

address.description: Only the coarse parts of the address: enough to check a state or pincode, nothing street-level.

vendor_ref.description: Opaque upstream reference for support correlation. Never parse it.
